text: On June 10, 2019, the Nominating Panel - Rooming House Licensing Commissioner and Deputy Commissioner conducted interviews and recommended two candidates to City Council for appointment as the Rooming House Licensing Commissioner and Deputy Commissioner.

City Council on June 18 and 19, 2019, adopted the following: 1. City Council appoint the following candidate as the Rooming House Licensing Commissioner for a term of office ending on November 14, 2022, and until a successor is appointed: Alison Griggs 2. City Council appoint the following candidate as the Rooming House Licensing Deputy Commissioner for a term of office ending on November 14, 2022, and until a successor is appointed: Keith Cooper 3. City Council direct that Confidential Attachments 1, 2, and 3 to the report (May 31, 2019) from the City Clerk remain confidential in their entirety as they relate to personal matters about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment as the Rooming House Licensing Commissioner and Deputy Commissioner.
